entries.en: to wait (aguardar, i.e. esperar); to stop
to wait; to stand by
to wait a little; wait a moment
to stop, halt one's steps; to wait on the way (detener el paso)
to wait a short while
to listen; to wait, heed
to wait for, await (orders, news)
at one's convenience; to be ready and prepared (per estar presto y apa…)
entries.notes: 西语词头截断（estar presto y apa…），aparejado 为推断展开；中义以汉字「听便」为准。

entries.en: to await dispatch on an errand; to wait to be sent somewhere
entries.notes: 西语短语缩写且语序残乱（q̃ uer donde le embian＝wait where they send him），词义依汉字「听差」定夺。

entries.en: to wait
to wait until all are present; to wait alike/equally (igualmente)
to wait for, await
to wait, await

entries.zh: 待慢；慢慢等候，又通「怠慢」（慢待轻忽）
entries.en: to wait slowly, delay (despacio); cf. 怠慢 to slight or neglect
entries.notes: 「待慢」字面为慢慢等候，与西语 despacio 相合；又与「怠慢」同形，故并注。

entries.en: to await one's time / opportunity
to wait until the appointed time (si viene a tiempo)
to keep for another time; to defer, put off
to save / keep a little (L: aguardar vn poco, to wait a little)
entries.notes: 西语「aguardar vn poco」（稍候）与汉字「留几粒」（留下少许）不甚吻合，释义从汉字与音写。

entries.en: to lodge, stay as a guest (hospedándose)
to drool, saliva flowing (as when waiting long, chewing the bit)
entries.notes: 西语以「久候如嚼衔（ut mascando freno）」之喻释「涎流」，四栏借此互证。

entries.zh: 安命；听天由命、静待时运
entries.en: to await one's fortune; to resign oneself to fate (aguardar ventura)
to wait a little longer, a bit more
